name: Analytics Bento
description: Dark analytics dashboard bento: a Projects Stats table (icon rows with budget and progress badges), a Performance Analytic up/down bar chart with tooltip pills and a Daily selector, and a tall Integration Analytic card with an area chart (peak tooltip) over a list of platform integrations with progress badges.
interactions: cards fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-adb-up, staggered)
Performance chart: purple bars scaleY from the center baseline up and orange bars scaleY down, 700ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), per-bar transition-delay
Integration area chart: the line strokes in via stroke-dashoffset (wpmn-adb-draw, 1.4s) with a gradient fill and a peak dot + tooltip
cards brighten their border on hover
prefers-reduced-motion: bar grow + line draw off, reveals rendered in place
